findings.actual: The current checkpoint schema fixes requested_branch to autopilot/2026-09-16-idea-scout-v2. The successor plan §4.5 requires autopilot/2026-09-17-idea-scout-v2-successor, while design §14 and interfaces §14 repeat the predecessor branch. findings.actual: The checkpoint contract requires the receipt's design fingerprint to match the current intent/design snapshot. The only published benchmark-freeze receipt is the predecessor receipt, which records the v14 design fingerprint 0221dc2ccd6851b03fceebbe251b2d324239be533e3713468755ab32d9f92196, while this successor review subject has fingerprint 823e3a3065dd8cef57d02d548745a9a62506ec3b67fd439b1525558f13e9b31a. The evaluation plan says to reuse that receipt and not re-freeze. No exception in the active checkpoint schema permits this predecessor fingerprint, leaving the required C-V2-16 freeze gate unconsumable for T04-T06.
findings.claim: The frozen predecessor benchmark receipt does not bind the current publication
findings.evidence: idea-scout-v2-checkpoint-contract-successor-v1#/definitions/benchmark_freeze; idea-scout-v2-checkpoint-contract-successor-v1#comment; idea-scout-v2-predecessor-evidence-v1#/benchmark_freeze_receipt; idea-scout-v2-evaluation-plan-successor-v1#successor-predecessor-binding; bundle.json#/identity/subject_fingerprint

findings.actual: The active CT-V2-CHECKPOINT-R15 contract lists only T04-R15, T05-R15, T06-R15, and T11-R15 as consumers. findings.expected: One RawItem may yield zero or multiple semantic signal records in one versioned extraction revision.

findings.expected: Every ResearchAttempt contains a question outcome keyed to every question in its ResearchPlan; missing outcomes are invalid.

findings.expected: The T02 persistence layer includes the normative source_approvals and quick_validation_plans records, including the QUICK idempotency seam consumed by T04 and T05.

findings.actual: An update rewrote settings_snapshot_json and changed region_profile_id from western to cis without rejection.
findings.claim: Search Run immutable settings and exact profile bindings can be rewritten after creation.
findings.evidence: context/interfaces-v3.md:85 requires an immutable settings snapshot and exact profile version. | candidate/migrations/009_v2_core.sql:76-104 defines the columns and foreign keys but no immutability trigger for those fields. | The independent mutation updated settings_snapshot_json and changed region_profile_id from western to cis without rejection.
findings.expected: A Search Run retains its immutable settings snapshot and exact Region/Domain Profile versions after creation.

findings.actual: research_questions rows have plan/attempt foreign keys but no constraint that their IDs match questions_json. The Quick-plan trigger validates Candidate target/revision only; the ResearchAttempt validator checks outcome keys but not normalized question rows. A disposable SQLite probe accepted q2 for a plan declaring only q1.
findings.claim: Persisted research questions and QUICK-plan refs are not bound to the exact questions declared by their ResearchPlan.
findings.evidence: candidate/migrations/009_v2_core.sql:281-294,332-344; candidate/src/idea_scout/store/store.py:391-427. The disposable SQLite probe reproduced the mismatch.
findings.expected: Research questions and QUICK-plan question refs correspond exactly to the immutable plan questions; attempts preserve outcomes for that same exact question set.

findings.actual: Revision and active state exist only on semantic_signals rows. When extraction yields zero rows, there is no persisted revision, no active marker, and no way to distinguish a successful zero-signal result from an unprocessed RawItem.
findings.claim: A zero-signal extraction cannot persist or activate its extraction revision.
findings.evidence: candidate/migrations/009_v2_core.sql defines revision/active only on semantic_signals (lines 115-143) and all active-revision triggers operate on those rows (lines 516-574); the independent mutable-copy structural probe fails because no extraction-revision record exists.
findings.expected: A RawItem may yield zero or multiple Semantic Signals, and every reprocessing extraction creates a durable revision whose active state supersedes the previous revision without deleting history.

findings.actual: Store-level attempt insertion checks exact JSON outcome keys, but plan insertion permits zero normalized rows, schema triggers check only inserted IDs, and QUICK insertion requires merely a non-empty unique subset. Independent probes committed a declared question with zero normalized rows and a two-question plan with a one-question QUICK reference list.
findings.claim: ResearchPlan questions, normalized question rows, attempt outcomes, and QUICK references are not required to correspond exactly.
findings.evidence: candidate/src/idea_scout/store/store.py:254-318 and 391-427; candidate/migrations/009_v2_core.sql:281-454; failing mutable-copy probes CHK-T02-QUESTION-CORRESPONDENCE.
findings.expected: Every declared plan question has a normalized row, every attempt outcome covers exactly those questions, and a QUICK plan carries the exact question refs for its Candidate revision; missing question outcomes or references are invalid.

findings.actual: The migration blocks updates to settings/profile columns but defines no append-only/no-delete guard for search_runs. A newly created run with no children was deleted successfully in the independent probe, permitting recreation under the same ID with changed settings.
findings.claim: Search Run settings immutability can be bypassed by deleting and recreating the run.
findings.evidence: candidate/migrations/009_v2_core.sql:65-111 and 509-515; failing mutable-copy probe CHK-T02-SEARCH-RUN-DURABILITY.
findings.expected: A durable Search Run retains its immutable settings snapshot and exact profile versions for its lifetime; persistence must not permit the same run identity to be rebound to different settings.
